title: OPT
description: Only the Necessary To Make Your Game Smooth.
body:
<details>
<summary>DISCLAIMER</summary>
I use Performium as a modpack comparator, not because it's a bad modpack, but because it's one of the most famous ones. I selected it randomly, with no intention to offend either the creator or the modpack.
</details>



![WHY OPT?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e2bf6b23051d514e901bab5f44b3dad256980d4.png)

- While other modpacks focus on pure performance, **OPT** offers stability and an **almost** stutter-free experience.

- **OPT** doesn't limit itself to using the most famous mods. One of the main difficulties of this project was finding the **truly** important mods that **actually** make a difference in performance, without overloading the pack.

![comparion text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73b9ec62b38c1559a60db7dbec85937071b15a53.png)

_info: 12 chunks S / 12 chunks R ![comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49f4b723d16df527c089344501f6bd19c27d0ffc.jpeg)(the rest are the default configs of both)_
1. **OPT** (left side): 216 FPS  
2. **Performium** (right side): 175 FPS  
3. Tested looking at the same point and from the same position in both  
- Here we can notice that the modpacks react the same way to motionless testing, both performing very well.

### Now a chunk loading test:
_everything was recorded under the same conditions_

**OPT**

![OPT chunk_loading](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20e5fbaa1de2875709db97ebd35f37779f518b8d.gif)

**Performium**

![Performium chunk_loading](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33638b6fc3a3156f07224794672d26a26bdac0e9.gif)

~~I didn't record the whole screen because it was drastically impacting the framerate, I'm sorry~~

- As you can see, that's the problem. The game starts to stutter as soon as you enter unloaded chunks, and it's not only a problem with Performium — it happens in almost every optimization modpack. **OPT** aims to mitigate this problem (as seen in the demonstration) and does so by using mods that fix most of the underlying clutter that causes it.


![ABAP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6dbf28c8ddf9944d126f64c7c98710dc2100dcd1.png)

- This was never supposed to be a **published** modpack. I was simply trying to optimize Minecraft, because every other modpack I tried had the same problems mentioned.
 
- As I was working on this project, I noticed the rise of performance mods in the Minecraft community, many of which fix issues that no other mods do. These mods were real lifesavers for the project. I recommend checking out each one for more detailed descriptions.

- All of the mods present here were handpicked to push Minecraft to the best of its capacity. I didn't just add what I thought was good — I tested every combination until I reached the final version.

- It's worth remembering that most (if not all) of the mods can be updated to the latest version.
